substrate-dev.description: Substrate development phrase (sp-core DEV_PHRASE) and the //Alice Ed25519 key that `subkey inspect --scheme ed25519 //Alice` prints

blake2_kat.description: Official BLAKE2 KAT: input bytes 00..n-1 for n = 0..255; keyed groups use key bytes 00..3f (BLAKE2b) or 00..1f (BLAKE2s); full-length digests. Values are SHA-256 over the 256 digests in input-length order.

substrate_ed25519.phrase: bottom drive obey lake curtain smoke basket hold race lonely fit walk

legacy_binaries.description: Static archives of the replaced binary targets, read from git history for the parity run
